verdict.rationale: Weave exposes a documented REST Service API for programmatic access to traces, evaluations, and data (wandb-weave-docs-15), plus Python/TypeScript SDK op decorators (wandb-weave-docs-4), OTel-compatible ingestion endpoints (wandb-weave-docs-14/41), and a verified live OpenAPI spec (wandb-weave-probe-3). This is corroborated by an official GitHub repo and public docs site with an llms.txt index (wandb-weave-probe-1/2). Missing for 10: independent third-party (non-vendor) confirmation that the public API is stable/versioned for production integration.
